connector.name: Cinderfi - Retirement Planning
connector.registryDescription: Retirement planning for Canada & US. CPP/OAS, Social Security, RRSP/TFSA, 401k/IRA, Monte Carlo.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.cinderfi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.cinderfi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token API key. Get one free at https://cinderfi.com/mcp
